summary: Main story cutscene in Spring Meadows; unmissable.
On the illuminated path near the second Paint Cage; check for the crystal.
After speaking to the Small Bourgeon, go west deeper into the cave; the journal is at the end.
From the Sanctuary Maze flag, take the west path downhill; the journal is near some corpses.
On the way to the arena, look left of the arena sign for a short side passage to the journal.
Late in the main quest, after Esquie knocks over a pillar, grapple across to the nearby abandoned camp.
On the world map directly north of Gestral Village; clear the rocks after completing Esquie’s Nest.
At Harvester's Hollow, head east and go up the slope; the journal is in the area surrounded by blue lamps.
From the slope leading to Expedition 38's journal, continue straight north to blue-lit Nevron corpses.
Near the Yellow Spire Wrecks checkpoint, head directly west; the journal is by a large hardened mass.
At the entrance, before fighting the Hexga, go the opposite way and climb the hidden rope to the upper area.
After the first cultists, follow the path ahead; the journal is at the base of a streetlight.
From the Paintress Shrine checkpoint, go north past the nearby Rocher; the journal is by discarded lamps.
After defeating the Giant Sapling, climb the rope behind it and take the side path on your left to the journal.
After unlocking Esquie’s swim ability in Act 2, swim south near The Meadows; the journal is by the canvas campground.
Behind the Chromatic Hexga boss; either defeat it or sprint behind it to grab the journal.
From Vanguard Point, climb down the cannon, go north to the Fading Woman, then take the east path into the trenches.
From Vanguard Point, go north past the Fading Woman, past the Paint Cage, then east; it's near the expeditioner with a trumpet head.
Head east on the world map from the Forgotten Battlefield to reach Stone Quarry; the journal is in this small area.
Near the eastern exit toward the snowy mountains, face the exit and look left for the journal by former Expeditioners.
After Monoco’s Station, enter Frozen Hearts, cross the tracks, and go behind the snow-covered train into the small cave.
Unverified: your scraper found no matching IGN description for this journal.
Found during a cutscene in Old Lumiere; unmissable.
On Left Street while playing as Maelle and Verso, go right onto the brick protrusion, jump into the hole, and open the door with the Old Key.
From Manor Gardens, take the east path, follow the light trail uphill, slide down the rope past the Paint Cage, and check the base of the golden blade.
After reentering Old Lumiere post-story, go forward from Manor Gardens, enter the broken Manor door, then check the bedroom nightstand.
In the optional area on the far northwestern world map, the journal is straight ahead from the entrance.
Before the bosses, right at the bridge; you can grab it without fighting them.
Speak with the Fading Boy, complete the Lady in Sap side quest, return when he moves, then go through the door; it's on your left after the stairs.
In this one-screen area west of the Act 1 mainland; the journal is in the crystal.
Once Esquie can swim through coral, go east of the Stone Wave Cliffs Cave; the journal is in the open near a tough enemy.
From the Dancing Classes checkpoint, go up the east stairs and look right for the glowing crystal.
From the Crumbling Path checkpoint, defeat Glissando, take the elevator behind it, and check directly across from where it lands.
In Anger Vale, find the blue-lit cavern in the far west, go right at the fork, enter the door, then head south into the next room inside the manor.
In Sadness Vale, head to the far northwest and climb to the highest point; the journal is by a former Expedition camp.
In Joy Vale, head west from the flag, climb the slope, then look left for a small campground among fallen Expeditioners.
On the small island northeast of Visages while heading to the Monolith; it's near the Gestral Merchant.
In Tainted Battlefield, turn left at the grave replica among the yellow trees, enter the Manor door, and check the center of the greenhouse.
From the tree in Tainted Lumiere, head west, grapple across two gaps, defeat the enemies, and check around the destroyed building.
In Act 3 outside the Opera House, go to the northwest ledge and fish the journal from the water.
After gaining flight, visit the eastern Gestral Beach and go directly right on arrival.
Raise Lune relationship to 5, visit after Act 3 starts, then go straight north and defeat the Chromatic Glissando; the journal is behind it.
Once Esquie can fly, land on the ledge west of the Forgotten Battlefield; the journal is near the tents on your left.
In the same area as Julie’s journal, go behind the tent and farther south by the destroyed building.
At the first fork in The Fountain, take the left path to the end; no combat is required.
Get the Dessendre painting in The Canvas, place it on the blank canvas in The Manor, then enter the newly opened far north room.
After the Ladder Area checkpoint, drop to the bottom, look west for the Manor door, and enter it.
As you continue climbing after the Foggy Area checkpoint, the journal is before the Peak checkpoint; use the balloon back down if needed.
Defeat Simon in Renoir’s Drafts; the journal appears in the center of the arena.
